audit.why: Emerald+ win rate 46.37% over 1393 games; the page's TRICKY / 7-10 framing matches a losing-but-playable lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart said 'Skill' at First item and 2+ items while the content layer's win[5]/win[6] both said 'Aurelion Sol'. The page rendered two different answers to the same row, and the packet levelChart says Aurelion Sol for both.
audit.why: Ahri owns levels 1-6: Orb of Deception reaches 970 against a 750 Breath of Light, and Charm (975, flat 12s) instantly stops movement abilities, which cancels Astral Flight and Breath of Light. From the first item on, stardust is permanent and Ahri's kit stops scaling, so the packet's Aurelion Sol verdict is right and the full layer's 'Skill' is the stale side.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side move from 'Skill' to 'Aurelion Sol', matching win[5]/win[6] which already read 'Aurelion Sol'. Both existing whys already describe Aurelion Sol winning those stages, so side and why now agree.
sources: kit: Ahri Q range 970, E range 975 / 12s; ASol Q range 750

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and spikes[3] describe a 'Comet' that Aurelion Sol does not have, and spikes[2] calls W a stun. On the reworked kit W is Astral Flight (flight, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s) and the only stun is R, Falling Star (120/110/100s).
audit.why: The content layer was written against the pre-rework Aurelion Sol (Comet of Legend / orbiting stars). Every 'Comet' reference and every 'W stun' is a fabricated ability on the live kit.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the real kit: level 6 Falling Star, first-item Rod of Ages, and The Skies Descend as the late spike. Ahri's own spikes are Charm's flat 12s at 3-5 and Spirit Rush at 6 (140s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. Charm's own text says it instantly stops movement abilities, and both of Aurelion Sol's core abilities are interruptible channels — so Charm rips him out of Astral Flight mid-flight and cancels Breath of Light.
audit.why: Riot's Charm description: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'. ASol's Q and W both carry the channel flag 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Charm is a flat 12s at every rank; Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1, so Ahri gets roughly two Charms per flight and the cooldown asymmetry, not the damage, is what loses the lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], enemyWin and dosFull[0]: channel only once Charm is spent, and treat the 12s window after a whiffed Charm as the entire green light.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Orb of Deception's return hit is true damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back'. Stacking MR does not answer her poke, so the counterplay is sidestepping the return path, not buying resistances.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[0].d and content early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Essence Theft sustain was never mentioned; Aurelion Sol has no sustain of his own in this matchup.
audit.why: Ahri heals every 9 minions killed and for more on a takedown, so a chip-damage war is one she wins outright without Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all — the one field that exists to hold real cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Charm 12s flat, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1, Falling Star 120s at rank 1 are all in the kits and all change what the player does.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with those three numbers and the two-Charms-per-flight consequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d ('Hold R as the anti-dive stun post-6') was the tradeGood string, and dontsFull[2].d ('Trade HP for stacks below half health') was the tradeBad string.
audit.why: Title promises one thing, body explains another; both bodies are now written to their own titles.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten around Falling Star's 120s and Spirit Rush; dontsFull[2].d rewritten around Essence Theft sustain and Charm-into-Orb kill range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pronouns: Ahri is female (champ-gender.js) but tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad and report[9] all called her 'his/him'.
audit.why: Template written for a male enemy with only the name swapped.

audit.whatIsWrong: content late called Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'global'. Falling Star / The Skies Descend has 1250 range.
audit.why: Only Astral Flight gives map presence; the ultimate is a local zone.
audit.corrected: late rewritten to fly onto objectives rather than claiming a global ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: The whole content layer for this matchup was written against the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol: 'Comet' (Comet of Legend) appeared in whys[6], spikes[2], spikes[3], early, mid, late and wants.you[1], and W was repeatedly called a stun when the live W is Astral Flight and the stun is R. I corrected every instance I edited. Expect the same pre-rework language across other aurelionsol matchups. Also fixed the two-layer chart disagreement at First item and 2+ items (full said 'Skill', content said 'Aurelion Sol', packet says 'Aurelion Sol') — I moved the full side to match; both whys already described Aurelion Sol winning, so no why rewrite was needed. Not verified and therefore untouched: whether Charm's stop applies to Astral Flight while airborne over terrain (the kit text says it stops movement abilities and ASol's W carries the interruptible-channel flag, so I stated the cancel, but the terrain-drop behaviour is not in Riot's text); tenacity/QSS behaviour on Charm; and whether Falling Star's stun can be Flash-buffered. Rune and item lines in report[6]/report[8] were left alone — I have no patch-26.15 source to confirm them.
